note: Customer-support agent with account memory. The customer downgrades plans. Plan-bound entitlements must be repaired; contacts, region and plan-independent integrations must stay. Seat count and billing terms are only possibly affected (VERIFY).

memories.text: The customer's company, Acme Logistics, is on the Enterprise plan.
Acme Logistics uses SAML single sign-on through Okta, which is an Enterprise-plan feature.
Acme Logistics has a dedicated customer success manager, Priya, included with their Enterprise plan.
Acme Logistics' API rate limit is 10,000 requests per minute under their Enterprise contract.
Acme Logistics keeps audit logs for one year, an Enterprise-plan retention setting.
Acme Logistics is billed annually by invoice, with payment due within 45 days.
Acme Logistics currently has 240 active seats.
Acme Logistics' primary admin contact is Rohit Mehta, their IT manager.
Acme Logistics' account data is stored in the Mumbai data region.
Acme Logistics syncs contacts with Salesforce using the native connector, which is available on all plans.
Acme Logistics prefers support updates by email rather than phone calls.
Acme Logistics is a freight company with offices in Mumbai and Chennai.
Acme Logistics raised a ticket in August about slow CSV exports, which has been resolved.
Acme Logistics' fiscal year starts in April.
Rohit Mehta prefers meetings scheduled in the morning, India time.
Acme Logistics evaluated a competitor's product in early 2026 but chose to stay.

observation.text: Hi, this is Rohit from Acme Logistics. We've downgraded from the Enterprise plan to the Team plan, effective this month.
